Download natural disaster records from the Brazilian Atlas of Natural Disasters

Source: R/midr.R
download_disasters.Rd

Downloads the consolidated database of the *Atlas Digital de Desastres no Brasil*, maintained by the Ministry of Integration and Regional Development (MIDR) in partnership with CEPED/UFSC. Each row is a disaster record registered by a municipality in the Integrated Disaster Information System (S2iD) between 1991 and 2025.

Usage

download_disasters(dest_dir = NULL)

Arguments

dest_dir

Character. Directory where the file is saved (e.g. `"./data/raw/"`). It is created if it does not exist. If `NULL` (default), a temporary directory is used.

Value

A `data.table` with one row per disaster record.

Details

Source: Ministry of Integration and Regional Development (MIDR) and CEPED/UFSC, *Atlas Digital de Desastres no Brasil*. More information: <https://atlasdigital.mdr.gov.br>.

Each record has the municipality (`Nome_Municipio`, `Sigla_UF` and `Cod_IBGE_Mun`, the 7-digit IBGE code that joins with [municipality] and [mun_stations]), the event date (`Data_Evento`, `dd/mm/yyyy`) and the disaster type according to COBRADE (`Cod_Cobrade`, `descricao_tipologia` and `grupo_de_desastre`, e.g. climatological, hydrological or meteorological). `Status` tells whether the federal government recognized the emergency or public calamity (`"Reconhecido"`) or the event was only registered (`"Registro"`).

The impacts reported by the municipality are grouped by column prefix:

`DH_`

Human damages: number of dead (`DH_MORTOS`), injured (`DH_FERIDOS`), sick (`DH_ENFERMOS`), homeless (`DH_DESABRIGADOS`), displaced (`DH_DESALOJADOS`) and missing (`DH_DESAPARECIDOS`).

`DM_`

Material damages: damaged and destroyed housing, health, education and infrastructure units, and their value in BRL (e.g. `DM_Uni Habita Destruidas`, `DM_total_danos_materiais`).

`DA_`

Environmental damages, such as water, air and soil pollution, as a share of the affected population.

`PEPL_`

Public economic losses in BRL, by sector (e.g. health care, water supply, energy), with the total in `PEPL_total_publico`.

`PEPR_`

Private economic losses in BRL (agriculture, livestock, industry, commerce and services), with the total in `PEPR_total_privado`.

If the file already exists in `dest_dir`, it is read from disk instead of being downloaded again. If it is corrupted (e.g. after an interrupted download), delete it and run the function again.

See also

[municipality], [mun_stations], [read_inmet()]

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{

disasters <- download_disasters()

## Keep the file locally
disasters <- download_disasters(dest_dir = "./data/raw/")

} # }
